teaser: Six a.m., the lunches are packed before anyone else is awake, and two cups of coffee are poured for people who have not yet said they wanted one — that is life path 6, and you carry it as an ESFJ, the type built to notice a want before it is spoken. The crossing does not simply add care to care. The 6 hands you a house, a table, a community to keep whole; the four letters already keep a running count of who needs what, and when. What is particular here is a person who has trouble telling the difference between loving a room and being responsible for it.
